scientific_queries.note: Consolidation update of SYNTHESIS.md to absorb C41/C42/C43; no new computation.

subagent_note: None dispatched: the round reclassifies the algorithm into two components and revises the promotion verdict accordingly.

core_change.before: the algorithm was presented as one chain whose rules had all failed to promote
core_change.after: the algorithm splits into A (ranking, no threshold, robust in six settings) and B (uncertainty bonus, needs an in-place threshold, fragile in three independent ways)
core_change.why_it_matters: the previous synthesis read ten rounds of threshold failures as invalidating the whole algorithm; those failures all live in B

new_evidence_absorbed.C41: ranking still has decision value on unseen drugs (+3.50 pp at k=20), so R2=0.029 does not mean worthless
new_evidence_absorbed.C42: ranking value is pool-size robust (+4.2 to +6.0 pp flat across a 100-fold pool range at fixed depth), unlike the uncertainty bonus
new_evidence_absorbed.C43: transfer boundary along joint novelty: unseen cell +6.88, unseen drug +5.00, both +4.00, strict +1.18 (CI includes 0, underpowered)

promotion_verdict_revised.A_ranking: promotable, but only as a baseline - it has no threshold and any off-the-shelf predictor does the same thing, so promotable is not the same as novel
promotion_verdict_revised.B_uncertainty: not promotable - does not transfer across populations (C38), in-place estimation is at chance (C39), harmful at small pools (C28)

limits: this is a reclassification, not a new experiment; any numerical error remains the responsibility of the original round
C41/C42/C43 are still exploratory (single dataset, retrospective, no independent batch), so 'A promotable' means 'fit for research code', not production ready
the C2 numeric issue from R65 (C40) is untouched
retrospective and read-only; no mechanism, clinical or drug-choice claim; no meta-learning or RSI
next_gates: if A is to become research code, the minimum is a rank_by_prediction function plus a test that reproduces C27/C41/C42 on a held-out pool - and it must be labelled a baseline, not a contribution
